rows.ARS:
Dark red Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: TANfudermos
Exhibition name: Sommerduft ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Hans Jürgen Evers (1940-2007) (Germany, 1985).
Introduced in Germany by Rosen-Tantau/Tantau Roses in 1986 as 'Sommerduft'.
rows.Bloom: Dark red. Moderate fragrance. 40 petals. Large, full (26-40 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Ovoid buds.
rows.Habit:
Glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: up to 4'7" (up to 140cm).
rows.Patents:
Australia - Patent No: 194 on 8 Oct 1992
Application No: 1991/038 on 16 Apr 1991 VIEW PBR PATENT
Synonym: Summer Fragrance. Applicant: Rosen Tantau.

This variety arose from the controlled pollination of two unnamed seedlings. The breeding work was conducted by Hans J. Evers for Rosen Tantau in Uetersen, Germany.

Patent surrendered on November 15, 2004.
rows.Notes: Tanfudermos was registered in Denmark on 30.5.1989
